reviews.title: Generic feel good nonsense
reviews.text:
Being involved in academics, I was intrigued by the concept. I searched for thermodynamics, mechatronics, engineering, and several other scientific and academic topics relevant to my studies. Every search came up empty. The ONE engineering result I found was an outdated, broken link to content that was no longer available. 
For an app charging nearly $100 a year, this is ridiculous. I can get more relevant educational content by simply tailoring my algorithms on YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, or practically any other free platform.

The concept has potential, but without meaningful content, what’s the point? As an educational resource, Deepstash has been an absolute disappointment and certainly isn’t worth the subscription price.

reviews.title: Same as TikTok?! NOT EVEN CLOSE.
reviews.text:
Same as TikTok?! NOT EVEN CLOSE.
Misleading absolutely!!

I was led to believe this was going to be “like TikTok for thinkers,” meaning it would have the same kind of free, easy, simple, and user-friendly experience. That description is completely misleading.

TikTok is FREE. It is incredibly easy to navigate, easy to connect with, and designed to be user-friendly. Your app cannot honestly be compared to TikTok in that regard.

Yes, I understand that your platform is designed as a learning app. That’s fine. But it isn’t FREE. And when you advertise it as “TikTok for thinkers,” people naturally expect some of the same accessibility and ease of use.

Frankly, I feel like I was misled and had my time wasted because I downloaded this believing I was getting something free and easy to use. If you want people to overlook the other shortcomings of your app, make it FREE first.

The statement “It’s like TikTok for thinkers” is, quite frankly, bull... Don’t compare your product to TikTok when it doesn’t provide the same basic accessibility, simplicity, or mainly FREE user experience.

Thank you for nothing—and thank you for wasting my time.

I will call out the one good thing the authors did; to include in the description the clear explanation of what the differences are between the free and paid versions. Yes, everyone gets rid of ads, but delineating the other features was welcomed and far too few apps do this.

reviews.title: Deepstash Cancellation & Refund Issues
reviews.text:
I would strongly caution people about the trial and cancellation process.

I signed up for the 7-day trial and attempted to cancel before it converted into a paid subscription. The cancellation process was unnecessarily difficult, and I was unable to successfully complete it.

I was then charged $69.99 for a subscription I did not intend to keep. When I contacted Deepstash, they offered me only a 50% refund while allowing me to keep the subscription.

What concerns me most is the lack of a straightforward cancellation and customer-support process. When I was trying to cancel, I did not have an easy way to contact the company and confirm that the cancellation had actually gone through.

Deepstash now says its records do not show my attempted cancellation. That does not reflect my experience. I made an effort to cancel during the trial because I did not want a paid subscription.

I have requested a full refund and management review. Based on my experience, I would be very cautious about signing up for the trial.

reviews.title: Beware of their subscription model and terrible customer service
reviews.text:
I am bumping this up to two stars only because they offered me a bundle with their other apps, but otherwise, this is a terrible experience.
I downloaded Deepstash on the App Store, but the app redirected me to an external website to pay for the subscription. Because of this bypass, the subscription does not appear under your Apple Subscriptions, making it completely invisible when you try to audit or manage your active free trials. I feel like it's very predatory the way that they direct people to a different website to handle billing.
I accidentally signed up for the trial and realized it the very next day. I emailed their support team within 24 hours to explain the mistake and request a cancellation and refund. They completely refused to process a refund.
Do not sign up for the free trial through their app unless you want to risk getting locked into a payment that you can't track or cancel easily through your device settings. Steer clear of this predatory setup.

reviews.title: This is how to do it!
reviews.text: I am dyslexic, so as one would imagine, reading is not fun or easy for me.  Breaking down useful books into bite size take aways has been amazing.  This app has improved my personal life & my work life.  At my company we use a lot of Toyota methods, going through “Why Toyota is the best company in the world” has been insightful, and helpful.  The practice at the end of each lesson is ideal to make sure I am understanding the key take away.  I am actually absorbing knowledge through the way this app teaches.  Fantastic!

reviews.title: Not Title Specific
reviews.text:
I really enjoy Deepstash, especially the read-aloud feature. Being able to listen to the content makes it easy to learn while driving, working out, or multitasking.

One area that could use improvement is content accuracy and feedback. I’ve come across a few titles where the title or topic didn’t seem to align with the information actually being presented. When that happens, there doesn’t appear to be an easy way to flag that specific book or piece of content as inaccurate or not functioning properly.

It would be helpful to have an in-app feedback/report option within each book or summary, allowing users to quickly identify issues such as incorrect content, mismatched titles, audio problems, or other errors.

Overall, I think Deepstash is a great way to get a quick overview of a subject and plant that initial “concept seed” that makes you want to explore a topic more deeply. With a better content-level feedback system, the experience could be even stronger.

The charge went through automatically via the bank’s card updater service. When I immediately contacted Deepstash support to explain that I don't use the app, urgently need these funds, and didn't realize my new card would be charged – they completely refused to issue a refund.

Absolute lack of customer care and zero empathy. Avoid this app!

reviews.title: Drop the Cartoon Mascot
reviews.text:
Great concept, but the mascot drove me away

I’m exactly the kind of person this app should appeal to. I enjoy reading short, interesting, thought-provoking ideas and was interested enough to download the app and try it. Unfortunately, the cartoon mascot was everywhere, and I found it so distracting and irritating that I stopped using the app.

The content is aimed at intellectually curious adults, but the mascot and cartoon-heavy presentation made the experience feel unnecessarily juvenile to me. I don’t need a cartoon character to encourage me to read or learn.

I would genuinely reconsider subscribing if there were a setting to turn off the mascot and use a clean, adult, text-focused interface. Please consider giving users that option.

In fact, I used Claude and ChatGPT to try to understand if I was on the simplest level, like for someone very young because I couldn’t figure out how to turn the dial up in the app and I was so surprised by how simplified everything is, which is not a good thing  that I was questioning whether I was on the difficulty level or something of that nature. I’ve never done a review for an apple before and I’ve purchase plenty of times. If you’re looking for something really simple then this might be a good fit for you. But if you’re actually trying to learn, I don’t think this is going work for most people.
